responsibility: Implements Rust implicit coercion rules in the typechecker, including never-type coercions, borrowed and raw pointer coercions, autoderef-based receiver matching, mutability checks, and unsized conversions such as array-to-slice and concrete-to-dyn-trait reborrows. It drives coercion by walking adjustment chains through AutoderefCycle, returns the resulting type plus recorded Adjustment sequence for later code generation, and emits coercion-specific diagnostics for mutability or object-safety related failures.
same_name_distinction: Provides the coercion engine’s implementation: it performs coercion attempts, drives autoderef-based matching, handles pointer/reference and unsized coercions, and reports mutability or object-safety failures. Unlike rust-coercion.h, this file contains the operational coercion algorithms and adjustment production.
